gizmo.title: Liiska tallaabooyinka
gizmo.description: Tallaabooyin lambaraysan oo lagu dhammaystiro hawl.

configure.title: Tilmaamaha tallaabada
configure.description: Muuji tallaabooyinka sida saf koobban oo cinwaanno ah oo calaamadeeya horumarka. Nuxurka tallaabada laguma muujiyo qaabkan.

configure.title: Tallaabada hadda
configure.description: Tallaabada akhristuhu joogo, laga tiriyo 1. Tallaabooyinkii hore waxay u muuqdaan kuwo la dhammeeyay. Waxaa isticmaala tilmaamaha tallaabada.
